author: ETA PRIME
description:
In this video, we're taking a look at Linux running natively on the Odin 3! Thanks to a brand new nightly build of RockNix, we can finally harness the Snapdragon 8 Elite to run a native ARM64 version of Steam—turning this powerful Android handheld into a mini Steam Deck.

Buy The Odin 3 Here: https://www.ayntec.com/products/ayn-odin-3?sca_ref=9882300.ExzzUJHDgM

Learn More About Rocknix:  https://rocknix.org/
ROCKNIX Nightly: https://github.com/ROCKNIX/distribution-nightly/releases

We check out the UI, dive into the specs, and push the Odin 3 to its absolute limit by testing out a ton of PC games including Cyberpunk 2077, Doom Eternal, Halo 3, and more. It’s still early days for Linux on this device (and that fan gets loud!), but the future of ARM-based handheld gaming is looking incredible.
